simple.meaning: שֶׁפֶךְ (shephek) is a Hebrew word meaning “an emptying place, e.g. an ash- heap.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שֶׁפֶךְ (H8211) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Leviticus 4:12, with occurrences in Leviticus.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שֶׁפֶךְ (H8211) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שֶׁפֶךְ (shephek) / H8211 is traced through Leviticus 4:12 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: an emptying place, e.g. an ash- heap
definitions.full: H8211. shephek שֶׁ֫פֶךְ noun [masculine] place of pouring ; — construct ׳שׁ הַדֶּשֶׁן Lev 4:12 (twice in verse) (P).

occurrences.englishText: —all the rest of the bull—outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire. It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out.
